1.text: Mwana wanjye ita ku bwenge bwanjye,Tegera ugutwi ubuhanga bwanjye,

2.text: Kugira ngo uhore witonda,Kandi iminwa yawe ikomeze ubwenge.

3.text: Kuko iminwa y'umugore w'inzaduka itonyanga ubuki,Kandi akanwa ke karusha amavuta koroha,

4.text: Ariko hanyuma asharīra nk'umuravumba,Agira ubugi nk'ubw'inkota ityaye.

5.text: Ibirenge bye bimanuka bijya ku rupfu,Intambwe ze ziherera ikuzimu.

6.text: Bituma atabona inzira y'ubugingo itunganye,Kugenda kwe ni ukuzerera atabizi.

7.text: Noneho bahungu banjye, nimunyumvire,Kandi ntimwirengagize amagambo yo mu kanwa kanjye.

8.text: Cisha inzira yawe kure y'uwo mugore,Kandi ntiwegere umuryango w'inzu ye,

9.text: Kugira ngo utiyaka icyubahiro cyane ngo ugihe abandi,Cyangwa ngo uharire imyaka yawe abanyarugomo.

10.text: Abashyitsi be guhazwa n'ibiguturukamo,Kandi imirimo yawe ye gukorerwa mu nzu y'umunyamahanga.

12.text: Ukavuga uti “Ayii we, ko nanze kwigishwa!Umutima wanjye ukanga guhanwa.

13.text: Sinumviye amajwi y'abanyigishaga,Kandi sintegere amatwi abampuguraga.

14.text: Nari ngiye kurohama mu bibi byose,Imbere ya rubanda ndetse n'imbere y'iteraniro.”

15.text: Ujye unywa amazi y'iriba ryawe,Amazi ava mu isōko wifukuriye.

16.text: Mbese amasōko yawe yasandarira hanze,N'imigezi yawe yatemba mu mayira?

17.text: Bibe ibyawe bwite,Kandi ntubikorere ku nzaduka.

18.text: Isōko yawe ihirwe,Kandi wishimire umugore w'ubusore bwawe.

19.text: Nk'imparakazi ikundwa n'isirabo nziza,Amabere ye ahore akunezeza,Kandi ujye wishimira cyane urukundo rwe.

20.text: Mwana wanjye, kuki wakwishimira umugore w'inzaduka,Ukagira ngo uhoberane na we?

21.text: Kuko imigendere y'umuntu iri imbere y'amaso y'Uwiteka,Kandi ni we umenya imigenzereze ye yose.

22.text: Umunyabyaha azafatwa no gukiranirwa kwe,Kandi azakomezwa n'ingoyi z'icyaha cye.

23.text: Azapfa azize ko yanze kwigishwa,Kandi ubupfapfa bwe bwinshi buzamutera kuyoba.
